DES MOINES, EARLHAM, EXIRA, FONTANELLE, GREENFIELD,
GUTHRIE CENTER, INDIANOLA, JEFFERSON, LAMONI, LENOX, LEON,
MOUNT AYR, NEW MARKET, NORWALK, OSCEOLA, PANORA, PERRY, STUART,
WAUKEE, AND WINTERSET.

SCATTERED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS TO 70 MPH POSSIBLE.
ISOLATED LARGE HAIL EVENTS TO 1.5 INCHES IN DIAMETER POSSIBLE.
